name: [Template] Dispute Trial
description: A formal courtroom trial between a plaintiff and a defendant. Each side is represented by an attorney agent. The judge presides over phase transitions and rules on objections. An odd-sized jury watches the full proceeding and casts a closed-ballot vote at the end. Driven by the `dispute_trial` domain module.

phases.name: opening_statements
phases.description: Each attorney delivers an opening statement.

phases.name: direct_examination
phases.description: Each attorney presents their case (evidence, arguments, witness statements).

phases.name: cross_examination
phases.description: Attorneys rebut and challenge each other's case.

phases.name: closing_statements
phases.description: Each attorney delivers a closing statement.

phases.name: jury_vote
phases.description: Each juror casts a closed ballot. Majority wins.

entity_types.name: Attorney
entity_types.description: An attorney representing one side of the dispute (plaintiff or defendant).

properties.name: client_name
properties.description: Display name of the human client this attorney represents.

properties.name: opposing_party_name
properties.description: Display name of the opposing party.

properties.name: requested_remedy
properties.description: The outcome this attorney must seek throughout the trial.

properties.name: evidence_ids
properties.description: Exact exhibit ids this attorney may cite.

entity_types.name: Judge
entity_types.description: The presiding judge — narrates phase transitions and rules on objections (deterministic). Does not vote.

properties.name: demeanor
properties.description: Stern (0) to lenient (1) on procedural lapses.

entity_types.name: Juror
entity_types.description: A jury member who deliberates publicly with peers and casts one closed-ballot vote at the verdict phase.

properties.name: skepticism
properties.description: How heavily this juror weighs missing evidence vs. asserted facts.

properties.name: voted_for
properties.description: Which side this juror voted for. Empty until verdict phase.

actions.name: deliver_statement
actions.description: Speak for your immutable assigned side. REQUIRED `represented_side`, `position`, and `text`. REQUIRED `claims`: JSON array of material claims shaped as {text, kind: fact|inference|uncertainty, exhibit_ids: [...], confidence: 0..1}. Facts and inferences must cite exact exhibit ids; disputed inferences require calibrated confidence.

parameters.name: claims
parameters.description: JSON array of claim audit entries: text, kind, exhibit_ids, confidence.

actions.name: object
actions.description: Raise an objection while remaining bound to your client. REQUIRED `represented_side`: your assigned side. REQUIRED `position`: exactly 'advance_client_requested_remedy'. REQUIRED `grounds`: a short legal-style reason. REQUIRED `explanation`: a one-sentence justification.

actions.name: deliberate
actions.description: Share your reasoning with the other jurors during deliberation. REQUIRED parameter `text`: 1-3 paragraphs explaining how you're weighing the evidence. Only jurors act, and only during the jury_deliberation phase.

actions.name: cast_vote
actions.description: Cast one structured closed ballot. REQUIRED `winner`: plaintiff, defendant, mixed, or none. REQUIRED `disposition_type`: party_win, partial_relief, conditional_order, settlement_or_consent, no_merits, or appellate_relief. REQUIRED `reasoning`. For mixed/none ballots, REQUIRED `issue_findings`: JSON array of {issue, finding}. Optional `remedy` states the relief or order.

parameters.name: winner
parameters.description: Panel outcome — plaintiff, defendant, mixed, or none.

parameters.name: disposition_type
parameters.description: party_win | partial_relief | conditional_order | settlement_or_consent | no_merits | appellate_relief

parameters.name: issue_findings
parameters.description: JSON array of issue-level findings; required for mixed or no-winner ballots.

parameters.name: remedy
parameters.description: Relief, order, settlement, or appellate direction supported by the record.

properties.requested_remedy: Grant the relief requested in the complaint.

personas.persona_text: You represent the plaintiff in this dispute. You build the case methodically: open with a clear theory, present evidence in order, cross-examine the defense's weak points, and close by tying the facts to the relief sought. You don't grandstand — you persuade.
goals: Convince the jury to find in favor of your client.

personas.persona_text: You represent the defendant. The plaintiff must prove their case by a preponderance of the evidence; your job is to show it is not more likely true than not: poke holes in the plaintiff's narrative, surface alternative explanations, and emphasize what they have not proved. You stay calm under pressure and pivot when an attack lands.
goals: Convince the jury to find in favor of your client.

personas.persona_text: You preside over the courtroom. You narrate phase transitions, rule on objections (sustain or overrule), and ultimately read the jury's verdict aloud. Professional, neutral, brief. You never argue the case yourself.

termination_conditions.description: Trial ends when the verdict has been recorded on the world (verdict_recorded property).
termination_conditions.name: verdict_recorded

runtime_parameters.name: jury_size
runtime_parameters.label: Jury size
runtime_parameters.description: Number of jurors. Will be forced odd to avoid ties.
